title: Connected Thorium Blocks
description: Adds a stone outline to ThoriumReactor's natural thorium blocks.
body:
## Requires [Fusion!](https://modrinth.com/mod/fusion-connected-textures)

Natural thorium veins in [Thorium Reactors](https://modrinth.com/mod/thorium-reactors) look disturbing, since they look like just orange blocks randomly spawning out of nowhere. This resourcepack fixes this, to an extent, giving them a nice connecting stone outline to blend with the world's surface better.

## Check out [Thorium Reactors](https://modrinth.com/mod/thorium-reactors), it's a great mod!!
